_about: High Stakes: the room behind some of a fork's doors where a player bets HP on one brutal question (right: a reward pick; wrong: a quarter of their max HP). These are its own questions, harder than the hardest in the question database and kept apart from it, so the fight never asks them. Each is { Category, Text, Right, Wrong: [three] } (the answers are shuffled when it's asked). A match asks the ones whose Category matches one of its categories (the names on the admin page: "Music", "TV & Movies"...) when there are any, and any of them when not. Read at startup: a question that breaks the admin editor's rules (250 letters for a question, 80 for an answer, four different answers) stops the server with the problem spelled out. Add freely.
